claim.title: Lenses make many points: Pure point spectrum disproves Simon's L² conjecture
claim.version: v1,22 October2026; current primary submission history still onlyv1 on3November2026
claim.locator: Theorem1.1, equations1.1 and definition of I_d,sigma

scope_comparison: Theorem1.1 constructs for every d>=2 a real smooth bounded nonnegative V, on domain H²(Rd), with I_d,0(V)=integral |x|^(1-d)|V|² finite and Pc(H)=0 while sigma(H)=[0,infinity). Since (1+|x|)^(1-d)<=|x|^(1-d) for x!=0, it satisfies the local less singular weighted condition. Pc=Pac+Psc=0 contradicts infinite ac multiplicity at almost every positive energy, not merely absence of a transport estimate. Thus a counterexample meets every stated local hypothesis.
